Name: Monster Shed
Author: BeckyShark
Description:
[center][i][b]** My mods will [/b][b]only[/b] [b]be uploaded on Nexus **[/b][/i]

[size=6]﻿Monster Shed[/size]
[size=4]Shed Replacement for Content Patcher[/size]
[size=2][font=Georgia]- Huge amount of shed space for farmers who always want more![/font]

[font=Arial]This mod adds 5 [u]extra[/u] rooms aside from the vanilla shed space:
[/font][/size]
1 - 11 x 20 room
1 - 10x12 room (which some extra surrounding space)
3 - 16 x 131 rooms

Perfect for storage, furnaces, crystalariums and artisan-making!

Only the vanilla room that you enter in can be decorated with wallpaper and floors.
Feel free to request another version with different textures for other rooms!

[size=5][/size][size=5]Install
[/size]♥ [url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
♥ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
♥ Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
♥ Run the game using SMAPI.[/center]
